# keyframe-flow

> A animation-engine for web and Node.js. Define motion. Transform anything.

Documentation for keyframe-flow. Every page below links to its Markdown source; the whole site as a single file is at https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/llms-full.txt

## Animation
- [Animation](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/animation/index.md): An immutable, reusable animation definition (§5.1). Definitions describe motion; they are not playback instances and hold no execution state…

- [AnimationDefinition](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/animationdefinition/index.md): Any animation definition accepted by Animation.from() (§5.1).

## AnimationInterpolation

## AnimationKeyframesDefinition
- [AnimationKeyframesDefinition](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/animationkeyframesdefinition/index.md): Keyframe definition (§5.3, §5.4) with an eager keyframe source (§5.5).

## Clock
- [Clock](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/clock/index.md): A monotonic-ish time source returning milliseconds (§16). Clocks provide time; schedulers coordinate updates — scheduling is not timekeeping…

- [createFrameScheduler](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/createframescheduler/index.md): Creates the default frame scheduler (§16): requestAnimationFrame in browsers, timer-based scheduling elsewhere. Resolution happens at call time —…

## DOMMatrixLike
- [DOMMatrixLike](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/dommatrixlike/index.md): The named members shared by DOMMatrixReadOnly and DOMMatrix . CSSOM member names are transposed relative to conventional mathematical m<row><column>…

## DOMMatrixWritable
- [DOMMatrixWritable](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/dommatrixwritable/index.md): A mutable DOMMatrix instance with the subset of members used here.

## DOMPointInput
- [DOMPointInput](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/dompointinput/index.md): Input point for DOMMatrixWritable#transformPoint .

## DOMPointOutput
- [DOMPointOutput](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/dompointoutput/index.md): Point produced by DOMMatrixWritable#transformPoint .

## Easing
- [Easing](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/easing/index.md): Any easing: a built-in name or a custom function. Custom easings need no global registration (§8).

## EasingFunction
- [EasingFunction](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/easingfunction/index.md): Custom easing function (§8): maps normalized progress in [0, 1] to an eased value. Values outside [0, 1] are permitted (overshoot) but must be…

## EasingName
- [EasingName](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/easingname/index.md): A built-in easing name such as "linear" or "ease-in-out-cubic" (§8).

## EngineTickable
- [EngineTickable](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/enginetickable/index.md): The minimal contract the engine needs from a playback instance. Playback instances implement it; keeping it structural avoids a runtime import cycle…

## EulerAngles
- [EulerAngles](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/eulerangles/index.md): Euler angle triples in radians, X → Y → Z (§4.3).

## getDefaultEngine
- [getDefaultEngine](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/getdefaultengine/index.md): The lazily created shared PlaybackEngine used by playbacks that do not inject their own. It combines systemClock with the default frame scheduler (…

## GroupLayout

## HtmlTargetOptions
- [HtmlTargetOptions](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/htmltargetoptions/index.md): Options for html .

## Keyframe
- [Keyframe](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/keyframe/index.md): A generic keyframe: a value attached to a normalized position (§6.1). at is progress in [0, 1] , independent of duration (§6.2).

## ManualClock
- [ManualClock](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/manualclock/index.md): A clock whose time only moves when a test or host says so (§16). Ideal for deterministic playback tests: animation time is timestamp-based, never…

## ManualScheduler
- [ManualScheduler](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/manualscheduler/index.md): A scheduler that only fires frames when a test or host calls ManualScheduler.tick (§16). Pair it with ManualClock for fully deterministic playback…

## Playback

## PlaybackCancelledResult
- [PlaybackCancelledResult](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/playbackcancelledresult/index.md): The run was cancelled (superseded, cancel() , or disposal) before finishing (§12).

## PlaybackDirectionMode

## PlaybackEngine
- [PlaybackEngine](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/playbackengine/index.md): The centralized playback scheduler (§16). One engine drives all active playback instances: it reads the current time from its injectable Clock ,…

## PlaybackEngineOptions
- [PlaybackEngineOptions](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/playbackengineoptions/index.md): Injectable time sources for a PlaybackEngine (§16).

## PlaybackFinishedResult
- [PlaybackFinishedResult](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/playbackfinishedresult/index.md): The run reached its natural end (§12).

## PlaybackOptions
- [PlaybackOptions](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/playbackoptions/index.md): Construction options for Animation.attach / Playback .

## PlaybackResult
- [PlaybackResult](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/playbackresult/index.md): Outcome delivered by the finished promise of a playback run (§12).

## PlaybackState
- [PlaybackState](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/playbackstate/index.md): The lifecycle states of a playback instance (§12).

## QuaternionLike
- [QuaternionLike](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/quaternionlike/index.md): Any value that can be read as a quaternion {x, y, z, w} (§4.3).

## QuaternionObject
- [QuaternionObject](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/quaternionobject/index.md): Any value that can be read as a quaternion {x, y, z, w} (§4.3).

- [RotationMode](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/rotationmode/index.md): How rotation interpolates between keyframes (§9.1). "quaternion" (default): SLERP with shortest-path — the correct choice for orientations, but…

## Scheduler
- [Scheduler](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/scheduler/index.md): A frame callback source (§16). One request schedules exactly one callback invocation — the same contract as requestAnimationFrame — and cancel…

## SvgTransformElementLike
- [SvgTransformElementLike](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/svgtransformelementlike/index.md): The structural subset of an SVG element the adapter needs — anything with setAttribute works (SVG 1.1 transform attributes), no DOM lib types.

## systemClock
- [systemClock](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/systemclock/index.md): The default clock: performance.now() when available, otherwise Date.now() . Works unchanged in browsers and Node.js with no browser-API dependency…

- [Transform](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/transform/index.md): An immutable transform with the canonical component representation { position, rotation: Quaternion, scale } (§4.3), available as the frozen…

## TransformComponents
- [TransformComponents](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/transformcomponents/index.md): The canonical component representation of a transform (§4.3): position, quaternion rotation, and scale. Shared by the transform and matrix…

## TransformComponentsInit
- [TransformComponentsInit](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/transformcomponentsinit/index.md): Canonical construction input; omitted (or undefined) parts default to identity.

- [TransformInit](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/transforminit/index.md): Developer-facing construction input (§4.1). Rotation may be given as a quaternion or as Euler angles in radians [x, y, z] — the convenience…

## TransformKeyframe
- [TransformKeyframe](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/transformkeyframe/index.md): A transform keyframe as authored (§6.1). easing controls the interpolation from this keyframe to the next one (§8); it is omitted on the final…

## TransformKeyframeSource
- [TransformKeyframeSource](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/transformkeyframesource/index.md): Sources accepted for keyframes definitions (§5.4): arrays, synchronous iterables, generator instances, and functions returning synchronous…

## Vector3
- [Vector3](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/vector3/index.md): An immutable 3D vector in the library's right-handed coordinate system (§4.4). All operations return new vectors; instances are never mutated (§4.2).

## Vector3Like
- [Vector3Like](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/vector3like/index.md): Any value that can be read as a 3D vector: an Vector3Object , or a [x, y, z] tuple (§4).

## Vector3Object
- [Vector3Object](https://johnsonjo4531.github.io/keyframe-flow/docs/vector3object/index.md): Any {x, y, z} object readable as a 3D vector — the structural form of Vector3Like .
